clips.text: Rain can fall in the hills while the swimming spot stays sunny.
Once a wall of water appears, there may be ten seconds or less to get out.
FloodHerald links an upstream sentinel to a riverside guardian by radio.
A flood alert sounds the siren on site, with no internet needed.
Person detected: a spoken warning, with no flood alert or siren.
Next: a swimming area, with a flood upstream.
Everyone has left the riverbed, and the alarm stays on.
The warning came before the water did.
Recovery is compressed for this demo.
Both water states must stay valid and normal, and the travel-time margin must expire.
Zero detections never clear the alarm.
For deployment, we plan a compact Raspberry Pi and UGen300 node for on-site person detection.
Intended buyers are local governments. The code is on GitHub.
